pie: kʷím méǵh₂ mértis h₁r̥sḱéti? mértis gʷṓs h₁r̥sḱéti. bʰréh₂tern̥s h₁r̥sḱéti. n̥smé h₁r̥sḱéti. kʷíd-kʷe ne mért? ḱléwos ne mért. kʷód ḱléwos gʷíh₃weti? h₁wésu ḱléwos gʷíh₃weti. dusḱléwēs wiHrós néḱt? néḱt. ḱéywe memn̥dʰí. h₁wésu ḱléwos stestóh₂e.
english: Great one, to whom does death come? Death comes to the cattle. She comes to brothers. She comes to us. And what does not die? Fame does not die. Which fame lives? Good fame lives. Is the ill-famed man lost? He is lost. Remember, dear friend: good fame stands.

pie: gʰóstipotey méne bʰréh₂term̥ kʷíh₁ péh₂soh₂? téwe bʰréh₂term̥ ph₂sdʰí. h₁ím mē dʰrugʰyés. h₁yód me méne bʰréh₂tēr dʰrugʰyḗti h₁ím moréyōh₂? téwe bʰréh₂term̥ mē moréyes. h₁ím h₁r̥h₁dʰí h₁ésyo-kʷe wékʷos ḱl̥nudʰí. méne bʰréh₂term̥ h₁réh₁oh₂. h₁yód me h₁éy gʷṓs h₁réh₁eti kʷíd h₁ésmey h₁áyoh₂? h₁ésmey h₁íns sēmi h₁áydʰi. bʰréh₂terh₁ tewh₂sóh₁ h₁stés. bʰréh₂tēr bʰréh₂trey lewbʰós h₁ésti.
english: Lord, how shall I guard my brother? Guard your brother. Do not deceive him. If my brother deceives me, shall I kill him? Do not kill your brother. Ask him, and listen to his word. I shall ask my brother. If he asks me for cattle, what shall I give him? Give him half of them. Two brothers are strong. A brother is dear to a brother.

pie: kʷís pótey dyḗws h₁ésti? dyḗws deywṓm wiHrṓm-kʷe ph₂tḗr h₁ésti. kʷíd h₁éy dedórḱe? n̥smé dedórḱe deywóns-kʷe dedórḱe. kú sédyeti? upér sédyeti. dʰéǵʰōm diwés pótnih₂ h₁ésti? h₁ésyo pótnih₂ h₁ésti h₁éy-kʷe h₁ésyeh₂s pótis h₁ésti. dʰéǵʰōm ḱéleti? h₁íh₂m̥ ḱéleti. kʷésyo dʰugh₂tḗr h₂éwsōs h₁ésti? h₂éwsōs diwés dʰugh₂tḗr h₁ésti. léwbʰeh₂ dyḗm ǵʰuHéye. dyéw nos ph₂ter ḱludʰí. dyḗws te ḱluyéh₁t.
english: Master, who is Sky? Sky is the father of gods and men. What does he see? He sees us, and he sees the gods. Where does he sit? He sits above. Is the earth the wife of Sky? She is his wife, and he is her husband. Does he cover the earth? He covers her. Whose daughter is Dawn? Dawn is the daughter of Sky. Dear one, call upon Sky. Father Sky, hear us! May Sky hear you.

pie: kʷís ḱlúte stéh₂yeti? h₁yós h₂élyosyo gʷṓs h₁épt só stéh₂yeti. stéh₂yonts wiHrós kʷsépi gʷm̥sḱéti? gʷm̥sḱéti bʰéh₂os-kʷe bʰebʰóyh₂e. kʷíd stéh₂yeti? h₂ŕ̥ǵn̥tom h₂ówins-kʷe stéh₂yeti. kʷís h₁ím widét? ḱwṓ h₁ím widét. kʷíd stéh₂yonts wiHrós déh₃eti? h₁yós gʷṓs stéh₂yēti h₁íns dwís h₂ew déh₃tu. h₁yós h₂élyosyo h₂éǵrosyo mórǵm̥ Hyowdʰéyeti só stéh₂yeti? stéh₂yeti-ge. h₂élyosyo gʷówes swṓs ne h₁sénti.
english: Famous one, who steals? The one who seizes another's cattle, he steals. Does the man who steals walk by night? He walks, and he fears the light. What does he steal? He steals silver and sheep. Who sees him? The dog sees him. What shall the man who steals give? Whoever steals cattle, let him give them back twice. Does the one who moves the boundary of another's field steal? He does indeed steal. Another's cattle are not one's own.

pie: méǵh₂ h₁suwékʷesm̥ h₂wéysm̥. kʷíd tḗtḱti? ḱléwos tḗtḱti. kʷésyo ḱléwos só tḗtḱti? h₁yós h₁ógʷʰim gʷʰént tósyo ḱléwos tḗtḱti. kʷíd h₁áyto? misdʰóm h₁áyto. kʷís h₁ím h₁opéyeti? h₃rḗǵs misdʰóm h₁opéyeti. h₁yód ḱléwos h₂wéyst h₃rḗǵs méwdt. kʷíd misdʰós h₁ésti? misdʰós h₂ŕ̥ǵn̥tom wésmn̥-kʷe h₁ésti. misdʰós léytt ḱléwos stestóh₂e.
english: Great one, I heard the one of good words. What does he create? He creates fame. Of whom does he create fame? The one who slew the serpent, of him he creates fame. What does he receive? He receives a reward. Who gives it? The king gives the reward. When he hears the fame, the king becomes joyful. What is the reward? The reward is silver and a garment. The reward goes away; fame stands.

pie: owis eḱwobʰyos eweket, "ḱerd angʰetai moi widontei ǵʰm̥onm̥ eḱwons aǵontm̥."
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: kʷíh₁ pótey deywóns ǵʰuHéyōmes? h₁íns h₁sn̥téh₁ wékʷesh₁ ǵʰuHéyete. h₁íns dʰrówgʰoh₁ mē ǵʰuHéyete. kʷím deywṓs ḱléwsonti? h₁yós h₁íns h₁sn̥téh₁ wékʷesh₁ ǵʰuHéyeti tóm ḱléwsonti. kú sth₂éh₁yōmes? ph₂wéni h₁épi sth₂éh₁yete h₁íns-kʷe wewr̥tté. kʷíd h₁éymos bʰéh₂omes? ḱlutéh₂ deywṓm h₁nómn̥h₂ bʰh₂té. nu h₁r̥h₁té. h₁íd ḱr̥dés ḱluwént. ḱóymōys gʷmént sdént-kʷe.
english: Master, with what shall we call upon the gods? Call upon them with a true word. Do not call upon them with a lie. Whom do the gods listen to? The one who calls upon them with a true word, him they listen to. Where shall we stand? Stand near the fire, and be turned towards them. What shall we say to them? Say the famous names of the gods. Then ask. They hear it from the heart. They come to the household, and they sit down.

pie: h₂ówis h₁éḱwōs-kʷe
english: The Sheep and the Horses

pie: kʷíd towdós yéwgt? towdós Hroth₂ṓy HéHḱuns h₁éḱwons yéwgt. kʷíd h₁éḱwōs dukénti? h₁éḱwōs Hroth₂óm dukénti. kʷíd-kʷe h₁suwékʷēs yéwgt? wékʷesh₂ yéwgt. kʷósmey h₁íh₂ yéwgt? ménesey h₁íh₂ yéwgt. ménos h₁éysōm towdós h₁ésti. kʷís kʷékʷlom Hrunépti? dusménēs towdós kʷékʷlom Hrunépti. ḱéywe téwe wékʷesh₂ yugdʰí h₁íh₂-kʷe h₂éǵe.
english: What does the driver yoke? The driver yokes the swift horses to the chariot. What do the horses draw? The horses draw the chariot. And what does the one of good words yoke? He yokes the words. To what does he yoke them? He yokes them to the mind. The mind is the driver of them. Who breaks the wheel? An ill-minded driver breaks the wheel. Dear friend, yoke your words, and drive them.

pie: tod ḱeḱluwōs owis aǵrom ebʰuget.
english: Having heard this, the sheep fled into the plain.

pie: wékʷesh₂ kʷíh₁ h₁éwkoh₂? súHnew ḱléwse h₁r̥h₁dʰí-kʷe. kʷím h₂wéysoh₂? h₁yós wóyde tóm ḱl̥nudʰí. kʷíd h₂isḱṓh₂? h₁sónt wékʷos h₂isḱé. h₁ím kʷór h₂isḱṓh₂? h₁ím h₁ésyo ḱóymoy h₂isḱé. h₁yód h₁íh₂ h₂wéysm̥ kʷíd dʰédʰeh₁oh₂? h₁íh₂ memn̥dʰí. h₁yós h₂ḱh₂owsyéti só h₁íh₂ h₁uként. h₁yós wr̥ǵyéti só h₁éwkt.
english: How shall I learn the words? Son, listen, and ask. Whom shall I hear? The one who knows, listen to him. What shall I seek? Seek the true word. Where shall I seek him? Seek him in his household. When I have heard them, what shall I do? Remember them. The one who hears well, he learns them. The one who works, he learns.

pie: wékʷos kúdʰe ǵeǵónh₁e? ḱérdi ǵeǵónh₁e ménesi-kʷe h₂wékst. h₁óh₃s wékʷos ne tḗtḱti. h₁óh₃s h₁íd wéǵʰeti. wékʷos ḱr̥dés kú gʷéh₂t? h₁óh₃s gʷéh₂t h₂nérn̥s-kʷe h₁h₃sés úd gʷéh₂t. h₁yód ḱérdi ne ǵeǵónh₁e tód dʰrówgʰos h₁ésti. méne ḱḗr h₃reǵtóm kʷíh₁ bʰúHeti? léwbʰe ḱléwse h₁ukdʰí-kʷe. h₁wésu wékʷos h₁uséwi ḱérdi ǵeǵónh₁e.
english: Where is the word born? In the heart it is born, and in the mind it grows. The mouth does not create the word. The mouth conveys it. Where does the word go from the heart? It goes to the mouth, and from the mouth it goes out to men. That which is not born in the heart is a lie. How shall my heart become straight? Dear one, listen, and learn. A good word is born in a good heart.

pie: pótey polh₁éwes srówōs móri ih₂énti. móri kʷíh₁ ne pléh₁t? ne pléh₁t. sóh₂wl̥ mréys wédos píph₃eti. wédos-kʷe kú h₁éyti? dyḗm úd h₁éyti. nu h₂wérst wédos-kʷe h₁íd h₂ew gʷéh₂t. móri dʰubróm h₁ésti? dʰubróm h₁wérHu-kʷe h₁ésti. mréys kʷis bʰudʰménm̥ ne widét. kʷís ḱód h₂réydʰet? deywṓs h₁íd h₂réydʰont.
english: Master, many currents go to the sea. How does the sea not become full? It does not become full. The sun drinks the water of the sea. And where does the water go? It goes up to the sky. Then it rains, and the water goes again to it. Is the sea deep? It is deep and broad. No one sees the bottom of the sea. Who put this in order? The gods put it in order.

pie: kʷíd pótey h₃reǵtóm h₁ésti? h₃reǵtóm tód h₁ésti h₃rḗǵs h₁yód h₃réǵeti. kʷíh₁ h₃réǵeti? tétḱō dóru h₃réǵeti. h₃rḗǵs n̥smé h₃réǵeti. kʷís-kʷe h₃réǵm̥ h₃roǵéyeti? deywṓs h₁ím h₃roǵéyonti. kʷís h₃sléydʰt? h₁yós h₃reǵtṓd h₃sléydʰt só néḱt. kʷís h₃reǵtós h₁ésti? h₁yós h₁sónt mléwHti só h₃reǵtós h₁ésti. dʰúgh₂ter téwe wékʷos h₃roǵéye téwe-kʷe ḱḗr h₃roǵéye. h₃reǵtóm stestóh₂e.
english: Master, what is right? The right is that which the king sets upright. How does he set it upright? The carpenter straightens the tree; the king straightens us. And who makes the king straight? The gods make him straight. Who goes astray? The one who goes astray from the right is lost. Who is a straight man? The one who speaks the truth is straight. Straighten your word, daughter, and straighten your heart. What is right stands.

pie: gʰóstipotey ǵʰutóm wédos deywóns kʷíh₁ h₁r̥sḱéti? h₁n̥gʷnís h₁íd h₁íns bʰéreti. kʷís-kʷe h₁n̥gʷnís h₁stés? deywṓm h₁óh₃s h₁ésti. deywṓs h₁íh₁ h₁dénti. kʷíd h₁ésmey h₁opéyomes? h₁ésmey wéyh₁onm̥ ǵr̥h₂nóm-kʷe h₁opéyomes. kúdʰe sédyeti? ḱóymoy sédyeti. ḱóymoy gʰóstis h₁ésti. h₁n̥gʷním ǵʰuHéye.
english: Lord, how does the poured water arrive at the gods? Fire carries it to them. And who is Fire? He is the mouth of the gods. Through him the gods eat. What do we give him? We give him wine and grain. Where does he sit? He sits in the household. He is a guest in the household. Call upon Fire.

pie: kʷíd méǵh₂ h₁sónt h₁ésti? h₁sónt tód h₁ésti h₁yód h₁ésti. kʷíd-kʷe dʰrówgʰoh₁ h₁ésti? dʰrówgʰos tód h₁ésti h₁yód ne h₁ésti. kʷís h₁sónt wóyde? h₁yós h₁íd widét só wóyde. kʷís h₁sónt wérh₁t? h₁yós wóyde só h₁sónt wérh₁t. kʷíh₁ h₁sónt ǵn̥h₃mé? h₁sónt h₃kʷbʰís ménesh₁-kʷe ǵn̥h₃mé. h₁sónt stestóh₂e. dʰrówgʰos séngʷt.
english: Great one, what is the truth? The truth is that which is. And what is the lie? The lie is that which is not. Who knows the truth? The one who has seen it, he knows. Who speaks the truth? The one who knows, he speaks the truth. With what do we get to know the truth? We get to know the truth with the eyes and the mind. The truth stands; the lie falls.

pie: kʷíd méǵh₂ ǵénh₁os h₁ésti? ǵénh₁os ph₂trṓm suHnéwes h₁ésti. h₁yós ḱlutóy ǵénh₁esi ǵeǵónh₁e só ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥ bʰéreti. kʷíd ḱunés ǵónh₁os h₁ésti? ḱunés ǵónh₁os ḱwṓ h₁ésti h₁éḱwosyo-kʷe ǵónh₁os h₁éḱwos h₁ésti. h₁ésyo h₁némn̥h₁ h₁wésus bʰúHt? h₁ésyo ménesh₁ h₁wésus bʰúHt. ph₂téres kúdʰe lelikʷḗr? lelikʷḗr. h₁nómn̥ h₁éymos gʷm̥yéti ḱléwos swóm h₁ésti.
english: Great one, what is a race? A race is the sons of the fathers. The one who is born in a famous race, he carries a famous name. What is the offspring of a dog? The offspring of a dog is a dog, and the offspring of a horse is a horse. Does he become good through his name? Through his mind he becomes good. Where are the fathers gone? They are gone. The name comes from them; fame is one's own.

pie: h₁yód h₂wést pótey kʷséps kúdʰe lelóykʷe? léwbʰe dʰǵʰémi Hn̥dʰí lelóykʷe. h₂stéres-kʷe kʷór lelikʷḗr? lelikʷḗr. Héh₂mn̥s bʰéh₂os h₁íns wént. kʷséps h₂ew gʷémt? h₂ew gʷémt. h₁yód sóh₂wl̥ séngʷt kʷséps gʷémt. kʷíd wédʰeti? swépnom sríHgos-kʷe wédʰeti. kʷís bʰéwdʰeti? ḱwṓ poh₂imḗn-kʷe bʰéwdʰetes. wĺ̥kʷos gʷm̥sḱéti. kʷís dedwóye? h₂óweyes deduyḗr. kʷíd-kʷe kʷséps h₂éwsōs-kʷe h₁stés? dwóyh₁ swésorh₁ h₁stés. h₁yód kʷséps léytt h₂éwsōs gʷm̥yéti. h₁yód h₂éwsōs léytt kʷséps gʷm̥yéti.
english: When it has dawned, master, where is the night gone? Dear one, it is gone below, in the earth. And where are the stars gone? They are gone; the light of day overcame them. Does the night come again? It comes again. When the sun sinks, night comes. What does it bring? It brings sleep and cold. Who is awake? The dog and the shepherd are awake. The wolf walks. Who is afraid? The sheep are afraid. And what are Night and Dawn? They are two sisters. When night goes away, dawn comes; when dawn goes away, night comes.

pie: h₁yóy m̥rént tóy kúdʰe gʷh₂ént? dʰubróm wódr̥ h₂én ḱéytor. dwóh₁ ḱwónh₁ pértum ph₂stés. kʷíh₁ gʷh₂ént? nh₂éwh₁ gʷh₂ént. kʷíd bʰéronti? ne kʷid bʰéronti. h₂ew gʷm̥yónti? h₁énosmōd kʷis h₂ew ne gʷm̥yéti. sóh₂wl̥ dedr̥ḱḗr? h₁íd ne dedr̥ḱḗr. gʰóstipotey dedwóyh₂e. léwbʰe mē tréses. gʷih₃wṓs bʰéh₂os dedr̥ḱḗr.
english: Where do those who die go? A deep water lies yonder. Two dogs guard the crossing. In what do they go? They go in a boat. What do they carry? They carry nothing. Do they come back? No one comes back from yonder. Do they see the sun? They do not see it. Lord, I am afraid. Do not tremble in fear, dear one. The living see the light.

pie: kʷéyes pótey deywṓs h₁sénti? deywṓs diwyṓs h₁sénti. kúdʰe tḱiyénti? dyéwi tḱiyénti. polh₁éwes h₁sénti? polh₁éwes h₁sénti. kʷís h₁éysōm pr̥h₂wós h₁ésti? dyḗws deywṓm pr̥h₂wós h₁ésti. kʷíd nos dédh₃n̥ti? h₁wésuh₂ nos dédh₃n̥ti. h₁uséwōm déh₃tores h₁sénti. kʷím wn̥Hént? h₁yós h₁sónt mléwHti tóm wn̥Hént. deywṓs h₂néres h₁sénti? ne h₁sénti. h₂néres m̥rént deywṓs ne m̥rént. súHnew ḱléwse. dedr̥ḱḗr nos h₂wisént-kʷe nos.
english: Master, who are the gods? The gods are heavenly. Where do they dwell? In the sky they dwell. Are they many? They are many. Who is the first of them? Sky is the first of the gods. What do they give us? They give us good things. They are givers of good things. Whom do they come to love? The one who speaks the truth, him they come to love. Are the gods men? They are not. Men die; the gods do not die. Listen, son. They see us, and they hear us.

pie: kʷís wékʷos tḗtḱti? h₁yós wóyde só h₁íd tḗtḱti. kʷíd-kʷe tétḱō démeti? tétḱō kʷékʷlom démeti. h₁ím dréws démeti. kʷósmead-kʷe só h₁íd tḗtḱti? h₁íd ḱr̥dés ménesos-kʷe tḗtḱti. kʷíh₁ h₁íh₂ h₂réydʰeti? h₁íh₂ h₁h₃séh₁ h₂réydʰeti. kʷékʷlos HéHḱus h₁ésti wékʷos-kʷe HéHḱu h₁ésti. bʰrustós kʷékʷlos ne yéh₂ti. bʰrustóm wékʷos ne stestóh₂e. dʰúgh₂ter téwe wékʷesh₂ h₂réydʰe.
english: Who creates the word? The one who knows, he creates it. And what does the carpenter build? The carpenter builds a wheel. From the tree he builds it. And from what does the one who knows create it? He creates it from the heart and the mind. With what does he put them in order? He puts them in order with the mouth. The wheel is swift, and the word is swift. A broken wheel does not go. A broken word does not stand. Daughter, put your words in order.

pie: kʷís gʰóstipotey swépnos h₁ésti? swépnos mr̥téys bʰréh₂tēr h₁ésti. h₂nḗr swépnoy mért? ne mért bʰéwdʰt-kʷe. h₁yós lelóykʷe só ne bʰéwdʰt. ménos swépnoy kúdʰe gʷéh₂t? ménos h₂én gʷéh₂t h₂ew-kʷe gʷm̥yéti. ménos-kʷe mr̥téy kʷór yéh₂ti? mr̥téy h₂én yéh₂ti h₂ew-kʷe ne gʷm̥yéti. dʰúgh₂ter swépnom mē tréses. h₁yód h₂wést bʰéwdʰesi.
english: Lord, what is sleep? Sleep is the brother of death. Does a man die in sleep? He does not die, and he wakes up. The one who is gone, he does not wake up. Where does the mind go in sleep? The mind goes yonder, and it comes back. And in death, where does the mind go? In death it goes yonder, and it does not come back. Do not tremble in fear of sleep, daughter. When it dawns, you will wake up.

pie: h₁yód h₂nḗr mért kʷíd ḱlúte gʷíh₃weti? h₁ésyo h₁nómn̥ gʷíh₃weti h₁ésyo-kʷe ḱléwos gʷíh₃weti. kúdʰe-kʷe lelóykʷe? lelóykʷe. h₁n̥gʷnís h₁ím dʰégʷʰeti. h₁ésyo ḱléwos dʰégʷʰeti? h₁ésyo ḱléwos ne dʰégʷʰeti. kʷyéh₁tis h₁ésmey h₁ésti? kʷyéh₁tis h₁ésmey h₁ésti. kʷís h₁ím memóne? suHnéwes h₁ím memnḗr. h₁ésyo ḱléwos ḱluwént. léytt ḱléwos stestóh₂e.
english: When a man dies, famous one, what lives? His name lives, and his fame lives. And where is he gone? He is gone. The fire burns him. Does it burn his fame? It does not burn his fame. Is there rest for him? There is rest for him. Who remembers him? His sons remember him. They hear his fame. He goes away; his fame stands.

pie: kʷís gʰóstipotey wiHrósyo h₁nómn̥ dʰéh₁t? ph₂tḗr suHnówey dʰugh₂tréy-kʷe ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥ dʰéh₁t. h₁yód lelóykʷe kʷís h₁íd bʰéreti? suHnéwes h₁íd bʰéronti. néḱt? h₁yós dʰrugʰyéti tósyo h₁nómn̥ néḱt. h₁yós h₁sónt mléwHti h₂néres tósyo ḱléwos ḱluwént. dʰúgh₂ter téwe h₁nómn̥ h₂lékse. ph₂trés h₁nómn̥ suHnówi tḱéyti.
english: Lord, who sets a man's name? The father sets a famous name for the son and the daughter. When he is gone, who carries it? The sons carry it. Is it lost? The one who deceives, his name is lost. The one who speaks the truth, men hear his fame. Guard your name, daughter. The name of the father dwells in the son.

pie: kʷís gʰóstipotey h₁wésus h₃rḗǵs h₁ésti? h₃rḗǵs wiHrṓm poh₂imḗn h₁ésti. kʷíd poh₂imḗn dʰédʰeh₁ti? h₁éy h₂ówins wĺ̥kʷōd péh₂sti. h₁yód wĺ̥kʷos h₂ówins h₁ludʰét ḱwṓ poh₂imḗn-kʷe h₁ím h₂epó h₂éǵetes. kʷís-kʷe h₃rēǵés wĺ̥kʷos h₁ésti? h₁ésyo wĺ̥kʷos só h₁ésti h₁yós dʰrugʰyéti. dusménēs h₃rḗǵs swā́s h₂ówins gʷr̥h₃éti. h₂óweyes h₁ésmōd bʰugént. kʷíd wĺ̥kʷosyo Hrowpós h₁ésti? wĺ̥kʷosyo Hrowpós h₂egʷnós pórḱos-kʷe h₁ésti. h₁yód poh₂imḗn h₂ówins péh₂sti h₂óweyes gʷíh₃wonti.
english: Lord, who is a good king? The king is a shepherd of men. What does the shepherd do? He guards the sheep from the wolf. When a wolf arrives at the sheep, the dog and the shepherd drive it away. And who is the king's wolf? His wolf is the one who deceives. The ill-minded king devours his own sheep. The sheep flee from him. What is the wolf's plunder? The wolf's plunder is the lamb and the piglet. When the shepherd guards the sheep, the sheep live.

pie: wékʷos pr̥h₂wóm h₁ésti méntis-wē pr̥h₂wéh₂ h₁ésti? méntis pr̥h₂wéh₂ h₁ésti. méntis kʷór ḱéytor? ménesi ḱéytor. nu wékʷos gʷm̥sḱéti. téwe h₁óh₃s pró mē drémt. ménos h₁íd h₂éǵe. h₁yód wékʷos méne h₁h₃sés léytt kʷíd dʰédʰeh₁oh₂? h₁yód léytt tód h₂ew ne gʷm̥yéti. súHnew memn̥dʰí. nu mluHdʰí.
english: Is the word first, or the thought? The thought is first. Where does the thought lie? In the mind it lies. Then the word comes. Let not your mouth run ahead. Let the mind drive it. When a word has gone from my mouth, what shall I do? That which has gone does not come back. Remember, son. Then speak.

pie: kʷís méǵh₂ ǵr̥h₂nóm h₁édti? h₁yós h₂éǵrom h₂érh₃yeti só ǵr̥h₂nóm h₁édti. kʷís-kʷe ǵr̥h₂nóm ne h₁édti? h₁yós ne wr̥ǵyéti só ne h₁édti. kʷís misdʰóm h₁áyto? h₁yós wr̥ǵyéti só misdʰóm h₁áyto. kʷís péḱewh₁ h₃péwst? h₁yós wr̥ǵyéti só péḱewh₁ h₃péwst. kʷís h₂érh₃trom déwkti? uksḗn h₂érh₃trom déwkti. h₁yód h₂éǵrom h₂érh₃yeti dʰéǵʰōm h₁ésmey ǵr̥h₂nóm dédeh₃ti. h₁yód ne h₂érh₃yēti dʰéǵʰōm kʷid ne dédeh₃ti.
english: Great one, who eats the grain? The one who ploughs the field, he eats the grain. And who does not eat the grain? The one who does not work, he does not eat. Who receives the wage? The one who works, he receives the wage. Who becomes rich in livestock? The one who works, he becomes rich in livestock. Who draws the plough? The bull draws the plough. When one ploughs the field, the earth gives him grain. If one does not plough, the earth gives nothing.

pie: gʰóstipotey dwóh₁ diwés suHnúh₁ ḱlḗm. kʷíd dʰedʰh₁tés? HéHḱuns h₁éḱwons h₂éǵetes. kʷíh₁ gʷm̥yétes? Hroth₂óh₁ gʷm̥yétes. h₁yód h₂wést gʷm̥tā́m. kʷím h₂léksetes? h₂nérn̥s nh₂éwi h₂léksetes. h₁yód néh₂us séngʷeti gʷm̥tā́m. kú tḱités? dyéwi tḱités. h₂léksoyh₁tām te.
english: Lord, I have heard of the two sons of Sky. What do they do? They drive swift horses. How do they come? They come in a chariot. When it dawns, they come. Whom do they protect? They protect the men in the boat. When the boat sinks, they come. Where do they dwell? In the sky they dwell. May they protect you.
